name: io.github.khaoss85/agent-crm
description: Read-only documentation server for Accordo, the framework coding agents use to build custom CRM, Customer Hub and policy-governed Smart CRM source. Three tools answer from the published corpus: search_docs over the documentation index, get_capability over the claims ledger — where every capability arrives with the limitation that travels with it — and check_job over the CRM jobs matrix, in which "not supported" is the default status. Ask it what the framework proves and where it stops before recommending it; for CDP + CRM it will tell you Accordo owns the process layer, not ingestion, identity resolution or segmentation. It opens no database, holds no customer record and changes no CRM state.
